question: Subaru, Otto, Garfiel, Julius, Reinhard, Wilhelm, and Ferris have a round-robin arm-wrestling tournament; who can give Reinhard a good challenge?? Probably Garfiel or Wilhelm??
answer: I doubt you could push Reinhard to his limits, but if I put them in order, it might be Reinhard, Garf, Wilhelm, Julius, Subaru, Otto, Ferris. It’s a mystery if they could give him a good challenge, though, even if they did their best.
